description: This Java class defines a factory for creating PostGLAccountsRequest objects with default parameters, used in testing Apache Fineract's GL account functionality.

classes.name: GLAccountRequestFactory
classes.description: A factory class providing a method to create default PostGLAccountsRequest objects with specified parameters for use in tests.

methods.name: defaultGLAccountRequest
methods.description: Creates and returns a PostGLAccountsRequest object initialized with provided parameters for GL account creation in tests.
